HOW IT WORKS

Verified before
it’s listed.

Every product in the shop goes through the same four steps.

  1. 01

    AI finds makers

    Our AI searches overseas makers, what they make and the certificates they publish, then ranks the ones worth a closer look.

  2. 02

    FI Verify checks them

    We check business licences, certificates and test reports against the issuers’ own records, and note anything we couldn’t find.

  3. 03

    We list only what passed

    Products that pass go in the shop with an FI Score out of 100 and every check behind it, so you can see why we trust the maker.

  4. 04

    You buy and review

    Buy in a few clicks and get it delivered. Your review adds to the maker’s FI Score over time.

FI SCORE

Out of 100, for every maker and product. Checked certificates raise it, missing ones lower it, and buyer reviews add to it over time.
